observations: Two roughly oval head-forms sit side by side, each with spiral-filled eye sockets drawn in concentric loops of white, yellow, and red against a purple-red ground.

A dense grid of horizontal orange and vertical black lines covers most of the background, overlaid with loose blue spiral clusters in the upper corners and a pink zigzag running across the lower third.
Jagged yellow serrated edges line the top of each head-form, and a shared zone near center shows a yellow-outlined row of marks flanked by teal and white strokes.
reading: Two head-forms share the frame, their spiral eyes giving them a fixed outward stare that reads as confrontational or watchful. The warm orange grid presses against the figures rather than receding, so foreground and background compete at the same visual weight. Zigzag borders and looping blue lines keep the surface restless, while the paired arrangement introduces a quieter symmetry beneath the noise.
contextAngle: Within the owned nnotb subset, title neighbor nnxyz nnotb #234 uses a single head on a flat red field with sparse color, making this work's doubled figures and full-spectrum palette a strong contrast. The collector links nnxyz's looping line patterns to scrimshaw's incised spirals.
